units: <cite ref="Ketubot 111b:14">Keth. 111ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>ק׳ של כרוב</he> a cabbage stalk; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 7:3:15">Y. Peah VII, 20ᵇ</cite> top <he>ק׳ אחד של חרדל</he> a mustard stalk.

<cite ref="Pesachim 39b:4">Pes. 39ᵇ</cite> <he>אק׳</he> referring to the stalk (of the herbs mentioned); a. fr.—Pl. <he>קְלָחִים</he>, constr. <cite ref="S00977"><he>קִלְחֵי</he></cite>, <cite ref="S00327"><he>קִילְ׳</he></cite>; <he>קוֹלְחוֹת</he>, <cite ref="S00977"><he>קִילְחוֹת</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 3:4:4">Y. Kil. III, 28ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>בעושה ק׳ יחידים</he> when planting single stalks, opp. <he>רצף</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Peah 3:5">Ib. 5</cite> <he>המוכר קלחי אילן וכ׳</he> if a man sells the stems of plants in his field (without selling the soil); a. e.—

<cite ref="Mishnah Menachot 10:4">Men. X, 4</cite> (<cite ref="Menachot 66a:17">66ᵃ</cite>) <he>בקנים ובקליחות וכ׳</he> (read: <he>ובקיל׳</he>; Bab. ed. <he>ובקולחות</he>; Mish. Cambr. <he>ובקִלְחוֹת</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 4) they threshed it with reeds and stalks of plants (instead of using flails); <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 28:6">Lev. R. s. 28</cite>; <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 18:1">Pesik. R. s. 18</cite> <he>ובקולח׳</he>; Pesik. Haʿomer, p. 69ᵃ <he>ובקלקת</he> (corr. acc.); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 643:22">Yalk. Lev. 643</cite> <he>ובקו׳</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Tahorot 2:1">Toh. II, 1</cite> <he>ספק שהק׳ וכ׳</he> if there is a doubt whether the jet touched her hand.
